essence: Borne pointed; opposed unopposed in me.
Impassioned cloth cast; bloodied hide told.
Dagger bared splitting; taken-world heroes best.
Noosed time counted; death's death shown.
Hurled to unmake; goad makes plain.
Bow shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer deer-pierced.

sections.SUMMARY: Light-bodied thought-power supreme goddess; hers the spreading of all. Bearing shown; world-opposed in me true-formed unopposed. Thread dissolved, sapless crowd; garland shown as-if to us. Look doubled at expelled nooses; gut-holding as-if appears speaking. Passionate cloth cast in highest heaven; bloodied hide head-borne told. Bared splitting by sword; world-taken heroes best. Fear-slayer lorded standing; shield-clash pointing us. Self-noosed, knowing-bodied, I count time; noose-held shown death's death. Difference-made hurled to unmake by own power; goad-held plain by supreme Bhairava. Bow-shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer pierced deer-like by power.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta of spreading goddess; vīra of unopposed-in-me; adbhuta of as-if showing; vīra of commanded seeing; adbhuta of cast cloth; vīra of best heroes; abhaya-vīra of fear-not; vīra of counted time; vīra of hurled distinction; vīra of deer-pierced cause

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wonder: bodied, spread, led. Spreading relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: borne, opposed, unopposed. Pointing relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: dissolved, garlanded, as-if. Showing relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: commanded twice, appeared. Commanding relished. The sthāyibhāva is wonder: cloth cast, hide told. Casting relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: bared, splitting, best. Baring relished. The sthāyibhāva is fearless exultation: slayer standing, shield shown. Fearlessness relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: noosed, counted, shown. Counting relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: hurled, goaded, plain. Hurling relished. The sthāyibhāva is exultation: shown bow, pierced deer. Piercing relished.
